create_ContextLog_payload: create a ContextLog payload from a Django request, response, and body with user and server metadata
send_ContextLog_event: send a ContextLog analytics event to tele.labelstud.io either synchronously or in a background thread
secure_ContextLog_data: secure ContextLog payload data by redacting sensitive fields from user-signup, user-login, and error responses
test_ContextLog_endpoint: test whether a Django request endpoint should be excluded from ContextLog analytics collection
review_ContextLog_browser: review the ContextLog browser detection logic that extracts user agent, device, and OS information
